analysis: Grouped feature-driver ablation for camera-ready interpretation

evaluation.models: Four independent L2-regularized logistic regressions per controller and feature configuration
evaluation.selection: Smallest qualifying pruned budget, otherwise dense
evaluation.threshold_calibration: Maximize dense avoidance subject to one-sided 95% Wilson upper bound <= 0.05; break ties by lower mean selected tokens and then threshold

interpretation.coverage_driver: A group drives coverage when its removal materially lowers dense avoidance.
interpretation.reliability_support: A group supports reliability when its removal increases unsafe acceptance or the Wilson upper bound.
